title: Locate target objects by searching countertops first
description: Use this when searching for food items like eggs in a household environment.
content: When looking for a food item such as an egg, check countertops before cabinets or other storage locations. Countertops often hold multiple food and utensil items, making them a likely place to find the target object.

title: Clean items at a sinkbasin before storing them
description: Use this when a task requires cleaning an object before placing it elsewhere.
content: To clean an object, first pick it up, then go to a sinkbasin and use the clean action with the sinkbasin. The sinkbasin does not need to be empty or specially prepared; cleaning can be performed even if other items are present.

title: Open containers before placing items inside
description: Use this when moving an object into a closed storage unit such as a fridge or cabinet.
content: Before moving an item into a fridge or cabinet, open the container first. Once the container is open, use the move action to place the item inside.
